title: I LOVE THE DROWSY CHAPERONE #breakingthebinary #drowsychaperone #jvp ...
transcript: not to be dramatic but this might be the best thing that has ever happened to me I feel like I do say that a lot but this this actually is The drowsy chaperone is one of my favourite musicals of all time great book great music it is incredible and this is the first time since 2006 that we've gotten a major presentation of it and it's going to be a one night only concert at Carnegie Hall even cooler this is the kick off of the breaking the Binary Theatre Festival which is a theatre festival all about employing trans non binary and two spirit artists and in that vein the entire cast of the drowsy chaperone is trans and non binary this is a truly stacked cast Laverne Cox as the drowsy chaperone perfection Jocelyn DeFreece as the underling Alex Newell as is Janet Peppermint as Mrs Tottendale JVN as man in chair perfection and of course Betty who as Robert has actually destroyed me it's also going to be directed by Tony winner L Morgan Lee which I absolutely love oh and tickets are going on sale in August so keep an eye out because I cannot miss this definitely check out everything that breaking the Binary Theatre is doing already but I am so excited to see this production it's going to be incredible I'm just at a loss I'm so excited October 20th Carnegie Hall see you there
classificationReason: Excitement/anticipation for an upcoming one-night concert presentation of The Drowsy Chaperone; the creator has not seen it yet. The show is not on the provided list.
